Rspack and Vant npm Cryptominer Campaign

Campaign: rspack-vant-cryptominer-2024
Date: 2024-12-19 to 2024-12-20 (1 day)
Attribution: Unknown attacker
Cause: Compromised credentials
Motive: Cryptojacking
Impact Type: Cryptojacking

Synopsis

The Rspack and Vant compromise used stolen npm publishing tokens to ship obfuscated XMRig cryptomining payloads through official packages on December 19, 2024. Sonatype reported that @rspack/core, @rspack/cli, and multiple Vant release lines showed identical compromise signs on the same day, pointing to a common actor. The campaign grouped popular frontend tooling and UI packages under one practical impact: developer installs became Monero mining launch points.

@rspack/core and @rspack/cli npm packages backdoored with XMRig
